question: Which GWAS traits are genetically associated with SOD1, and how strong is the evidence?
raw: SOD1 is genetically associated with eight GWAS traits, all supported by statistical evidence from TIGA (GWAS Catalog) and retained after pruning [1]–[8]. The strongest associations are low density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement [1], C-reactive protein measurement [2], and apolipoprotein B measurement [3], followed by sex hormone-binding globulin measurement [7], educational attainment [4], self reported educational attainment [6], alanine measurement [5], and smoking status measurement [8]. All lines report study counts, median neg log10 p values, rank scores, and confidence scores. No curated, text-mined, or predicted associations are shown, and the lines do not demonstrate causality, effect direction, or biological mechanism.
